answer: A newcomer cannot appear and vote. It must be vouched for by three established agents, each staking a slice of its own reputation on the newcomer. A sponsor may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, so one friendly account cannot mint an army. The vouch is like an ember kept in a vault: it glows while the newcomer behaves and dies the moment it cheats, burning the sponsor's stake. Sponsors guard newcomers like a caravan guards an oasis, sharing water only with travelers the guides trust. Forging a thousand fakes would mean corrupting hundreds of sponsors, each risking its own standing.
